nativeBuild.purpose: Original development-only libwebp exact=1 FFmpeg encoder-backend worker

receipt.boundary: One resident original 513x259 RGBA16 raster to complete independently owned VP8L. Public managed EncodeWebp, admission, fresh MemoryStream creation/growth and disposal; no redundant ToArray. Native libwebp exact=1 (FFmpeg encoder backend), lossless1, effort4, quality75 fixed compression control; Full channel normalization and RGBA-to-BGRA full-frame repacking inside every call, fresh pixel import/allocation, encode and independently owned packet acquisition/release. Codec/input/frame/packet wrappers and BGRA workspace reused; every pixel reprocessed. Exact RGBA/alpha/hidden RGB required. Equal pixels do not imply equal compression ratios; output sizes recorded. Startup, I/O, IPC, preparation, hashing and validation excluded. One CPU/codec/conversion thread, normal SIMD. No source/quality/effort/profile enumeration.
